name: smwgraphics-castlevania-dracula-x-moon
title: Castlevania: Dracula X - Moon
description:
The gorgeous bloodish moon seen in the map screen of Castlevania: Dracula X. Can be combined with other graphics to make an amazing night background. This version has better gfx optimization and map 16. A good fit for any night level.

Credit would be great, but it is optional.
